scope: Prevent two workspace tests from abandoning still-running detached services when a restored screen is visible before input acknowledgement.

defect.shape: Two lapis_session_service event loops and two signal-blocked process-group guards, with two fixture sleep children, remained after the workspace CTest case passed.
defect.root_cause: The size and plan tests called closeSession(..., abandon=true) after seeing terminal text but before inputReady(). The intended unreachable-session abandon path discarded the cards without sending terminate.

checks.command: LAPIS_GHOSTTY_PREFIX=<shared pinned prefix> python3 scripts/lapis.py build
checks.result: Configure, build, CTest, clang-format, Cppcheck and all clang-tidy shards passed.

checks.name: post-build-process-inventory
checks.command: ps axo pid=,ppid=,command= filtered by the isolated worktree path
checks.result: No service, guard, fixture CLI or sleep process remained.

non_claims: This repairs test teardown only; it does not change session-service shutdown behavior or qualify a packaged app.
